The Bharatiya Janata Party and the Shiromani Akali Dal on Tuesday announced the revival of their alliance ahead of the assembly elections in Punjab. The move comes six years after the Akali Dal walked out of the National Democratic Alliance over the farm laws. What has changed in the past 6 years, and how will this reunion impact the arithmetic in Punjab? Dr Ashutosh Kumar, Professor, Department of Political Science at Panjab University in Chandigarh, discusses with ThePrint’s Chitleen Sethi and Apoorva Mandhani in Political Adda.
